The structure of ZnCoS₂ (Zn₂Co₂S₄ per unit cell) is orthorhombic with space group Amm2 (No. 38). The cell contains 8 atoms distributed over 4 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers in tetrahedral S coordination (4 neighbors, 2.21–2.33 Å) and Zn centers in octahedral S coordination (6 neighbors, 2.35–2.37 Å). Corner-sharing is observed between Co tetrahedra and Zn octahedra, while Co tetrahedra and Zn octahedra share edges; the geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component.
